This is a **favorable environment for premium selling**, particularly in high-IV names where fat premiums compensate for wider strike cushions. Focus on tickers with technical support and avoid pre-earnings positions unless IV is exceptionally rich.

- **TEM:** High-risk ticker with 99% IV but erratic delta skew and thin OI; pass for execution risk
